1  cup sugar
1 1/2 cups finely diced pumpkin
1 cup whole milk
1 egg
1 tsp baking powder
1 tsp ground cinnamon
1/4 tsp ground ginger
1/4 tsp ground nutmeg
1/4 tsp salt
1 1/2 cups creamy or full-fat cream cheese, softened
1 1/2 cups granulated sugar
1 tsp vanilla

Instructions:

1. Preheat your oven to 350°F and line a deep 9-inch baking pan with parchment paper.

2. In a large bowl, combine the sugar and pumpkin and mix well to combine. You want to make sure that all of the pumpkin is coated in the sugar.

3. In a separate bowl, mix together the milk, egg, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and salt.

4. Pour the pumpkin and milk mixture into the bowl with the sugar and pumpkin and stir to combine.

5. In a separate bowl, beat the cream cheese and sugar together with an electric mixer on medium speed until smooth. Add the vanilla and beat for an additional second.

6. Mix the cream cheese mixture into the pumpkin mixture.

7. Pour the pumpkin mixture into a greased baking pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until knife inserted in the center comes out clean.

8. Allow to cool completely, then cover and store in the refrigerator until ready to serve
